summary: Close-up of the host at the window as he whips his head round, caught, and greets the guest with a nervous grin.
framing: Close-up of the host's head from inside the kitchen, eye level; open window behind him with the street outside (parked cars, red-roofed building at right, tree at left), strip of green wall and window frame at the left edge. Static.
props: window frame behind the host, view of the street

beats.action: head low at lower right of frame, turned away toward the window and tilted down, eyes wide with pupils at the right
head swings up and round toward camera-left
now facing 3/4 left, eyes wide and round, pupils centred, mouth a small o
head overshoots upward (top of hair leaves frame)
head settles down to centre frame, still wide-eyed, looking left at the guest; this pose held while he speaks
blink: lids half down at 1196, shut at 1197, half at 1198, open at 1199
eyes wide open again, same head position, speaking
head lifts and tips back to the upper right, teeth clenched
head comes forward and tilts, larger and lower in frame, wide eyes, fixed toothy grin; held to the end of the shot

notes: Camera confirmed static (background does not move; the size change at 1209-1210 is the head moving). The first three frames are a fast turn on ones; the rest is on twos. script.json puts the guest's shouted name (L15) ending at 1180, i.e. before this shot; nothing here contradicts that.
